name: Spool
maturity: Local-first JavaScript, Python and Go evidence product with one owner and isolated projects; bounded native, Sentry and OTLP-log intake, private source maps, operator corrections, owner/project erasure, sandbox reproducer, granted GitHub fix branches and exposure measurement. Runtime checks and review evidence are recorded separately; source metadata does not establish hosted, provider or npm publication acceptance.

spine.record: A sanitized JavaScript, Python or Go exception occurrence grouped into a project-scoped issue.

description: Investigate application errors with grouped issues, source maps and evidence for reviewing fixes.
scope: One owner identity per installation with multiple isolated projects and project-scoped ingest and read grants.

capabilities.description: Capture bounded native JSON and supported Sentry exception envelope/store evidence through project-scoped ingest authority, scrub common sensitive patterns, count/discard unsupported Sentry telemetry, and commit accepted events, groups, and local alerts atomically in D1. Unmodified browser/node SDK 11.6.0 verification programs exist; results are separate evidence, not inferred from package pins. See docs/SENTRY-SWITCHING.md.

Match bounded flat Source Map V3 artifacts to exact project, release, build, and debug identities; support owner uploads and CLI/Rollup/Vite plugin uploads using release/map-only project deploy keys. See docs/SENTRY-SWITCHING.md.
Inspect grouped issues and update revision-checked triage state with an audit trail.
Separate owner sessions, project ingest keys, and project read-only evidence grants.

Export Base portability archives and restore validated new or legacy data into an empty destination; manual retention invalidates stored snapshots and records occurrence tombstones. Owner-only project erasure uses the adopted Base helper with complete project cascades, anonymised audits, count-only receipts and restore fences. The owner-only Base import-kit organization adapter supports reviewed dry run, apply/resume and guarded undo, qualified with synthetic fixtures only. See docs/SENTRY-SWITCHING.md, docs/PROJECT-ERASURE.md, CONTRACT.md and ACCEPTANCE.md for custody, scope exceptions, external limits and five-minute timing.

Show stored project evidence and capture-coverage caveats in a responsive workbench, with per-project new-issue, regression and spike feeds, rules, delivery logs and scheduled evaluation/retry. Base Mail needs provider acceptance; HMAC webhook delivery requires a separately installed enforcing egress service with no ordinary-fetch fallback. No Oncall dependency or Slack integration is required. See docs/ALERT-WEBHOOKS.md.

Provide signed first-owner admission with an additive durable claim ledger, a native-owner-gated editor lease and pinned managed producer/package/setup metadata. Hosted installation and editor acceptance remain separate.

Accept bounded native and Sentry Python/Go exceptions with language-specific grouping, scrubbed structured or parsed-text frames and release-bound repository path mappings. Python/Go remain evidence only: no JavaScript source-map lookup, binary symbolication or sandbox execution. See docs/SUPPORTED-LANGUAGES.md.

Accept the documented bounded OTLP/HTTP JSON error-log profile through project ingest authority, registered release/build and origin checks. Traces, metrics, protobuf, compressed payloads and general OTLP compatibility are outside this adapter. See docs/OTLP-INTAKE.md.

Preview exact retained-occurrence split/merge corrections, apply and undo with revision and occurrence fences, retain original grouping provenance, assign operator labels, apply event-time literal suppression policies, and register immutable release/environment deployment manifests. Recognized bundle hashes support stable grouping without replacing native evidence. See docs/OPERATOR-CORRECTIONS.md.

Record supported mapped JavaScript ES-module reproducers and run them only in the separate local workerd sandbox with no network, secrets, files or app bindings, using a single-use expiring run token. Spool computes reproduced/not-reproduced/failed from runner observations and labels the verdict as evidence from uploaded source; unsupported inputs never run. See docs/REPRODUCE-AND-FIX.md.

After owner approval, carry a reproducer record through one GitHub fix branch and a draft pull request under an exact repository-scoped, expiring grant. Record provider receipts and revoke step tokens; never write the base branch, merge, force-push, tag, release or deploy. Requires the owner GitHub App connection. See docs/REPRODUCE-AND-FIX.md.

Measure affected-client cohorts, flow exposure, rollout, recurrence and capture gaps from stored reports and deployment manifests; missing denominators remain inconclusive. Random client identifiers and flow reports require SDK 0.2.0, which is owner-held and unpublished on npm. See docs/REPRODUCE-AND-FIX.md.

Erase the authenticated owner personal data only after a verified successor takes installation authority, using count-only preview, typed confirmation, resumable Base erasure and restore fences. Unsupported attribution and shared custody are explicit holds; external copies and configuration remain outside the fence. See docs/OWNER-ERASURE.md.

Allow the original deploying checkout and its provider credentials to request a private, one-use owner sign-in link with rer signin when mail is unavailable. Links expire within 15 minutes and remain owner-version-fenced; ordinary mail sign-in remains available. See docs/HOSTED.md.

nonGoals: Automatic hosted provisioning during local setup; actual owner-account deployment and mail sender acceptance require explicit owner action.
Sentry feature parity or a completed-migration claim; organization import has been exercised with synthetic fixtures only, and owner-export qualification is pending.
External paging, automatic retention, or guarantees of complete capture coverage.
Unbounded event payloads, remote artifact URL fetching, or execution of telemetry-provided instructions.

env.name: OWNER_EMAIL
env.why: First owner identity for Base operator-auth; supplied during local setup or through the owner deployment secret source.

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.why: Sign owner sessions; generated by local setup and supplied privately for deployment.

env.name: SETUP_TOKEN
env.requiredWhen: Claiming the first owner; generated by local setup and supplied privately for owner-account deployment.
env.why: Authorize the one-time first owner claim.

env.name: AUTH_ORIGIN
env.why: Exact trusted application origin; local setup manages it and deploy-kit derives the owner target origin.

env.name: AUTH_LOCAL
env.why: Explicit local auth mode; local setup selects true and deploy.json selects false.

env.name: MAIL_PROVIDER
env.why: Deliver sign-in links; local setup selects development and deploy.json selects resend.

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.why: Sender for sign-in links; local setup uses auth@localhost.test and deployment requires an owner-approved sender.

env.name: MAIL_API_KEY
env.why: Authenticate hosted mail delivery; not required by the development outbox or deploy dry-run.

env.name: MAIL_ACCOUNT_ID
env.requiredWhen: Selecting the Cloudflare mail provider instead of the declared Resend deployment.
env.why: Select the Cloudflare mail account for that optional server mail adapter.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
env.why: Select the owner Cloudflare account for deploy-kit; not needed for dry-run.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
env.why: Authorize deploy-kit provider operations; not needed for dry-run.

env.name: GITHUB_CONNECTION
env.requiredWhen: Advancing an approved GitHub fix-branch workflow against GitHub.
env.why: Server-only JSON containing the owner GitHub App appId, installationId and privateKey; absent configuration stops at Approved, awaiting connection without provider calls.

env.name: ALERT_DESTINATIONS
env.requiredWhen: Delivering project alerts to configured mail or webhook destinations; may remain empty when external delivery is unused.
env.why: Server-only destination JSON holds recipients, webhook URLs and signing keys; only safe IDs and labels are shown to the owner.

env.name: ALERT_DESTINATION_HASH_KEY
env.requiredWhen: Using configured mail or webhook alert destinations.
env.why: Stable Base64 key of at least 32 bytes for destination fingerprint HMACs; preserve it while deliveries are active. Setup generates it when missing.

env.name: ALERT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
env.requiredWhen: Including issue links in outgoing alert payloads; otherwise issueUrl is null.
env.why: Trusted exact HTTPS application origin for alert links; incoming Host is never used.

env.name: INTEGRATION_EGRESS
env.requiredWhen: Delivering signed webhook alerts through the separately installed enforcing egress service.
env.why: Trusted service RPC binding exposing send(WireRequest), not a secret string or ordinary fetch URL. The shipped deployment has no binding, so webhook delivery stays blocked until configured.

env.name: RER_OWNER_CLAIM_ISSUER
env.why: Exact trusted issuer origin for signed first-owner admission.

env.name: RER_OWNER_CLAIM_INSTALLATION_ID
env.why: Trusted installation identity bound into signed first-owner claims.

env.name: RER_OWNER_CLAIM_APP_ORIGIN
env.why: Exact application audience for signed claims; must equal AUTH_ORIGIN.

env.name: RER_OWNER_CLAIM_PUBLIC_KEYS
env.why: Public ES256 verification keys indexed by key ID; no private signing key belongs in Spool.

env.name: RER_IMPORT_DOOR
env.requiredWhen: RER provisions the install for a Business plan the owner approved; self-host rer deploy never sets it.
env.why: Exactly on: the owner's first claim opens the Business import door, which the owner can turn off in Settings. Any other value leaves it off.

env.name: RER_MANAGEMENT_ORIGIN
env.why: Exact authorized management origin for the optional owner editor and frame policy.

env.name: RER_INSTALLATION_ID
env.why: Installation identity used by the optional owner editor.

deploy.notes: Owner documents redirect unauthenticated requests to /sign-in. Bootstrap requires the one-time setup token; confirmation requires a valid sign-in token; ingest requires the project scoped Bearer key. Other auth and private API handlers enforce their own session or grant checks. /__dev/outbox is available only in explicit loopback development mode with host and request-context checks and the checkout private dev-key header or exchanged gate cookie. Deploy dry-run builds and validates Worker/assets, migrations and deploy.json without provider calls. Actual deploy-kit owner-account deployment needs explicit owner authorization, account credentials and mail configuration; live provider acceptance remains unperformed. Optional signed owner claim validates trusted deployment authority and creates only the first owner. /api/rer/cutover-status is POST only and needs a short-lived installation-scoped ES256 Run Edit Run grant of action cutover-status under the owner-claim key ring; it answers event and issue counts and the newest event time only, and 404 without that trust. Editor configuration independently requires a native owner session; project grants cannot authorize it.

limits.status: Product bounds are implemented locally; representative capacity and large-instance economics are unmeasured.
limits.restoreSemantics: Native v1/v2 and Base portability JSONL restore into an empty domain database, preserve private maps and browser origins, and exclude owner/authentication state and credential grants. All formats validate domain integrity and per-project capacities. JSONL has per-line and per-part bounds, not a 16 MiB total archive or 10,000-row per-table limit.

accessibility.status: Automated axe and responsive checks cover bounded local operator states; full conformance is not claimed.
includes: Local owner and project workbench states

operatingCost.status: Unmeasured; owner-account deploy dry-run is implemented, but no live deployment or provider acceptance is claimed.
